The recursive Volume carries the machine
without becoming one carrier.

This surface explains and exercises the existing resident mechanics while keeping definitions, derivations, executed properties, reference calculations, dependencies and environment boundaries distinct.

Primary question. Can recursive, overlapping, line-origin KEDDEH state spaces be developed into a native quantum-computational algebra—and what exact mechanics and evidence are required to get there?

Current research boundary. Q01–Q03 have executable local mechanics. Q04, the native weighted-state invariant, is the first unresolved mathematical dependency. Conventional separability/interference formulae remain reference oracles until a native KEDDEH state algebra exists.
QUESTION
Who has authority here?

Task authority and truth authority are intentionally separate.

Task authority
CURRENT EXPLICIT USER REQUIREMENT → accepted objective / decisions / obligations / constraints / conventions

The current user instruction can change what this system is required to do.

Truth authority
observed evidence → authoritative source → reproducible execution → corroborated evidence → derivation → inference → unknown

Evidence can change what may truthfully be claimed; it cannot silently rewrite the task.

Prohibited collapse. User authority does not manufacture a technical PASS; an internal continuation or previous stage instruction does not override the current explicit user objective.
QUESTION
Where does the mechanic actually live?

The state owner is braink://local/orchestrator. The descendant composes existing owners instead of replacing them.
